impl.summary:
Slice S4A (verify and candidate pages) is done in 1 commit on ux/s4a, not pushed, and the worktree is clean. Worker-phase checks are green: all 11 project-workflows specs (47 passed), 156 unit tests, 52 server tests, tsc and eslint. The candidate-phase Playwright run was not done; a script-only fixture parity check matched instead.

What changed on the pages:
- **Checks** (new src/projects/Checks.tsx): one row per check with glyph, check id matched by command, truncated command, +offset from attempt start, duration and exit code. The 'Show contents'/'Hide contents' buttons and the checks-list/.check/.check-exit testids are kept. A check the gate rejected is red even at exit 0, and its log opens at the end. cwd, log artifact id and UTC times are in the row tooltip.
- **Gate**: headline 'Failed: N checks rejected' plus the error code, then one gate-reason bullet per reason. A reason with no check id has no data-check-id and is also listed on the one check whose command ends the same way. The generic retryable sentence is gone.
- **Screenshots** (new src/projects/Screenshots.tsx): thumbnails at most 220 px wide that open in a native dialog. Esc closes it and focus returns to the thumbnail.
- **Closed disclosures**: Artifacts (a log that matches no check reads 'log (not a check log)'), Requirements on the verify node (built from node/Requirements.tsx, with the attempt cap) and Identifiers (session, both commits and the artifact sha256s, each shown once, in ResultFacts.tsx).
- **Candidate lanes**: a table comes first, failing lanes first and open, passing lanes closed. It works at 390 px with no sideways scroll. The per-lane ownership sentence and the intro sentence are gone.
- **New pure helper** src/projects/node/gate.ts (checkGate), covered by tests/unit/gate.test.ts.

The fixture (tests/project-workflows/fixtures/ux-verify.ts) adds the run run-rejected-checks. It has two keyed rejections at exit 0 on verify_ui attempt 1, an unkeyed 'Executed check failed: <path> -m workflow.run_tests' reason on verify_adapter attempt 1, and a candidate whose adapter lane was rejected at exit 0 with an extra setup log. The new spec is tests/project-workflows/ux-verify.spec.ts with the scenarios gate-rejected-checks and candidate-lanes-table. The handoff is at /home/agentops/dev/mdm-ux-s4a/docs/handoff/ux-s4a.md.

- `npx tsx --test server/projects.test.ts`: 52 passed (it validates every seeded fixture, including ux-verify).

impl.deviations:
1. I added the new files src/projects/node/gate.ts and tests/unit/gate.test.ts, and migrated one line of ux-node.spec.ts (S4-core's file).
2. NodeDetail.tsx now also shows `node-next` for a failed verify or candidate node that is the run's focus even when there is no command to type. Without it the requested 'assert node-next' cannot pass on run-failed, whose next step is 'No action: the supervisor retries by itself'.
3. On candidate lanes, the link to the lane's files and report is one 'Files and report ›' link inside the lane's summary row, and the worker-report-link paragraph is dropped there. The reason: clarity.spec.ts:246 finds that link by role, which skips content inside a closed lane, and passing lanes are now closed.
4. The test report stays in Other artifacts instead of attaching to the browser check row, because clarity.spec.ts asserts `artifacts` contains 'test_report'. Screenshots on candidate lanes stay in the lane's Screenshots block, not inside the browser check row.
5. Absolute check times are in the row tooltip (UTC) and in visually hidden `<time>` elements (chosen zone), so ux-time.spec.ts passes unchanged.
6. On candidate lanes the check offset is measured from the candidate attempt's start, which may be inferred.
7. Not done: the setup line, the lane row's 'attempt k of N / identical' note, test counts (waits on B5), and a policy.json for the scenario ids.

findings.summary: The GateFailure headline says 'Failed: no check was rejected' whenever the declared checks are unknown. declared is null, so checkGate gets [] and rejected is 0. This is a false claim, and it sits inside a role=alert region.
findings.failure_scenario: The run inputs route fails, or loads after the result (the implementer names this race), or the lane is missing from inputs.workers. Reproduced in a scratch copy with the inputs route returning 500 on verify_ui attempt 1 of run-rejected-checks. worker-error read 'Failed: no check was rejected; the gate recorded these reasons · VERIFICATION_BLOCKED' above the bullets 'frontend-unit: no passing test evidence…' and 'project-workflows-browser: …'. The gate did reject 2 checks. The lane table's Checks column also drops the ', N rejected' part in the same case. When the ids cannot be resolved, the headline should not claim zero rejections (for example 'Failed: the gate recorded N reasons').

findings.summary: Every candidate lane measures its check offsets from one attemptStart, the shown candidate attempt's start (timing.start.at). Lanes carry their own lane_results[].attempt, which can differ from lane to lane.
findings.failure_scenario: In the real workflow-guardrails-001 payload, the candidate node is at attempt 2 with lane_results controller attempt 1 (checks started 20:18:12–20:22:10Z) and ui attempt 2 (checks started 20:25:04Z or later). Measured against attempt 2's start (about 20:24:52Z), the controller lane's offsets are negative and silently hidden (offset >= 0 guard). If the start resolves to attempt 1 instead, the ui lane shows offsets of about +7:00 that are wrong. Traced from the payload, not rendered.

findings.summary: The 'Files and report ›' link now sits inside the lane's <summary>, which is exposed as a button. That puts interactive content inside an interactive element, the axe rule nested-interactive.
findings.failure_scenario: A screen-reader user reaches the lane summary and hears it as a button. The nested link is announced inconsistently or flattened into the button's name, and a tab stop inside a disclosure toggle is non-standard. The implementer moved the link there only because clarity.spec.ts:246 could not find it inside a closed lane. It could instead sit next to the details element, or the test could open the lane first.

findings.summary: The lane grid's fixed minimum columns (about 700 px) overflow the node area just above the 760 px breakpoint.
findings.failure_scenario: Probe run at a 761 px viewport on the candidate node: .lane-summary scrollWidth was 699 px inside a 669 px lane-results box. The row's link column spills 30 px past the node area's border. The document does not scroll sideways (scrollWidth 761), so this is visual clipping only. At 820 px and above it fits.

findings.summary: Only the row's title tooltip now says that a check's log is missing ('(not listed among the result artifacts)'). The old code showed this as visible text.
findings.failure_scenario: A check whose log_artifact_id is not among result.artifacts renders with no Show contents button and no visible explanation. Touch and keyboard users cannot read a div title, so the row looks like a check that simply has no log.

review.notes: I reviewed the diff feature/viewer-ux..ux/s4a (commit 8288993). I ran checkGate against every captured real result payload: ids resolve, candidate_ui/2 gets 1 rejected, and the deferred exit-2 and exit-1 checks in results/ui/1 stay deferred, not failed. I ran one probe Playwright spec from a throwaway copy in the scratchpad; the worktree is untouched and the copy is deleted. The probe covered widths 761, 820, 900 and 1000 on the candidate node, and the inputs route returning 500 on verify_ui attempt 1. The new assertions in ux-verify.spec.ts are meaningful. The red evidence consists of real assertion failures, not compile errors. The ux-node and projects.spec migrations are sound, and projects.spec.ts:305 asserts node-next as 12.3 requires. The dialog closes on Esc, returns focus, and has an aria-label. I found no execution controls and the page stays read-only. The pinned honesty substrings are unaffected; the ResultError retry and not-retryable lines are both removed. Minor quality notes: an onNavigate={() => {}} no-op is passed to RequiredChecks (harmless because checksNode is null). LaneResult recomputes checkGate on every render without useMemo (cheap). The lane sort reads useRunResults while each lane also calls useRunResult for the same key with a different stamp suffix.

outcomes.item: P2 GateFailure headline claims 'no check was rejected' when declared checks are unknown

outcomes.item: P3 candidate lanes share one attemptStart
outcomes.note: CandidateLanes now receives the timeline. Each lane measures its offsets from nodeTiming(timeline,'candidate',lane.attempt). The spec asserts this on run-identical: the adapter lane is at attempt 1 and the ui lane at attempt 2. Before the fix the adapter offsets were hidden.

outcomes.note: validateWorkerResult (contracts/workflow/v1.ts:165) rejects a result whose check log is not a listed log artifact ('Every executed check requires a log artifact'). Such a row never renders. A probe confirmed it: the viewer rejected the result as off-contract.

outcomes.item: 4.6 setup line 'Setup npm ci 42s (log)'
outcomes.note: S7 (B5 setup-log labels). The header already shows 'setup 42s'. Naming the setup command and its log needs B5.

outcomes.note: New lane-note on failing lanes: 'attempt k of N' on the lane's revision, plus the identical/repair part when Now's situation is blocked_identical for that lane. The attempts come from the diagnosis marker, otherwise the last two attempts. Asserted on run-identical and run-rejected-checks.

outcomes.item: Section 7 screenshots inside browser check row on candidate lanes
outcomes.note: When a lane declares exactly one browser check, Checks renders the Screenshots grid in that check's row through a new extras prop, and the lane has no separate Screenshots block. Asserted in candidate-lanes-table.

outcomes.note: It needs clarity.spec.ts:224 migrated (it asserts artifacts contains test_report on verify_ui). clarity.spec.ts belongs to S4b in this step. Do it after S4b merges, or in S7, which owns Checks.tsx.

outcomes.item: Section 7 worker-report-link missing on candidate lanes
outcomes.note: Each lane body now opens with WorkerReportLink. The summary row keeps lane-files-link, now labelled 'Files ›'. Asserted.

outcomes.item: 4.6 Artifacts summary should list kinds
outcomes.note: The summary (artifacts-summary) lists the distinct kinds, e.g. 'test_report · log (not a check log) ×2'. Asserted.

outcomes.item: 4.6 Requirements summary should mark candidate-gated checks and scenarios
outcomes.note: Checks the result recorded in deferred_checks are matched by command and marked '(candidate)'. Browser scenarios are listed, then 'timeouts · attempt cap N per revision · owned paths (n)'. The fixture's verify_ui attempt 2 now records deferred_checks. Asserted.

outcomes.note: Belongs to the S4b merge. S4b owns the Session disclosure and WorkerSections.tsx, which decides whether the launch node renders ResultFacts. Recorded as a follow-up in the handoff.

outcomes.note: The candidate adapter lane's failure now starts with 'Executed check failed: <path> -m workflow.lint_contract'. That tail ends no check's command. The spec asserts it is a gate-reason without data-check-id and is not on any row.

impl.summary:
Slice S4B is done: the launch page now shows 42 files in 2,248 px at 1440x900 (the old live page with 77 files was about 19,800 px). Committed as fd55f8b on ux/s4b; the worktree is clean. Section order is now Questions (only while one waits) → Report → Files → Task (closed) → Session (closed) → History.

- **Questions:** a waiting question comes first, with both answer commands (plain and --no-herdr) and the caveat line. The header no longer repeats those commands.
- **Report:** shown once, clamped to 3 lines with More, with 'as signalled by the session, not verified' said once. When the result's summary extends the worker's, only the added text shows as 'Verifier note: …'. Untested, verify-yourself and open assumptions sit behind counts; the falsifying check stays an inline link.
- **Files:** one ~32 px <details> row per file, listed from the worker's own freeze results/<lane>/1 plus any file a repair added. Nothing is fetched until a row opens, which the new files-dense scenario checks with page.on('request').
  - Rows with findings come first, then repair-touched rows, then the rest; a '⚒ repair 1 · changed|added' badge comes from comparing /1 with the latest result.
  - Filters are 'With findings n', 'Repair 1 · n' and 'All n'; 'Group by folder' appears from 10 files on.
  - An opened row shows the sha256, the findings as one-line chips with Show lines, then the content; Markdown opens on Rendered.
  - The review is read through useRunReview. A finding's file link opens its row and scrolls it into view.
- **Session:** a closed disclosure with the launch receipt, identifiers, the questions line and the stop line, now 'Stopped 10:20 · stop confirmed'. 'Observed state' is relabelled 'State at launch'; it and the launcher status are hidden once the stop is confirmed.
- **Task:** stays closed, and the finding → requirement flow still opens it.
- **New pure module:** src/projects/node/launch.ts holds the file-row, repair, report-delta, section-index and answer-command logic, with unit tests in tests/unit/launch.test.ts.

impl.deviations:
1. Section order follows PRD 4.5 (Report before Files, Task before Session). This meant migrating the clarity output-first order assertions, which 12.3 lists as unchanged; the old test pinned files before the report and the receipt before the task. "Report and Files precede the closed Task" still holds.
2. The Files index chip shows only the count. The "3 with findings · 2 by repair 1" detail is on the Files heading instead, because NodeDetail does not read the review.
3. Findings inside an opened row stay in review order, which clarity findings-on-files pins; the row's severity mark uses the most severe one.
4. The Show lines button keeps its range text ("Show lines 12–14" / "Show line 3"), which clarity pins, rather than the PRD's bare "[Show lines]".
5. answerNext copies the answer-command strings from triage.ts's questionNow, which is not exported and not in this slice's files.
6. Once the worker is stopped, the Launcher status row is hidden along with 'State at launch' (as PRD 4.5 says), so inputs.spec's 'attached_session_available' text check was dropped with that row.
7. The header's 'Working 12m · deadline …' line from 4.5 is not done, because NodeHeader.tsx is outside this slice.
8. NodeDetail.tsx changes are limited to the launch entries: it passes frozen and repairLabel, uses launchSectionEntries, and drops the header's repeat of the answer commands for this lane's waiting question.

findings.summary: The launch Files section reads the review through the shared, never-expiring review cache. While the review is still running, it asks for reviews/<attempt> by guessing the URL. The server answers 404 REVIEW_NOT_FOUND, orNotRecorded turns that into null, and useCached stores the null as a 'ready' entry for good. The comment says the review is asked again once the review node moves on, but it never is.
findings.failure_scenario:
1. Open launch_game while the review node is running (result_uri null, attempt 1). reviewUriOf returns `${paths.run}/reviews/1`, the fetch gets 404 REVIEW_NOT_FOUND, and the cache stores {status:'ready', value:null} under 'review:/api/.../reviews/1'.
2. The review finishes and the snapshot now carries result_uri '/api/.../reviews/1', the same key. The stamp changes (status or attempt), but useCached skips entries that are 'ready', so nothing is fetched again.
3. The launch page keeps saying 'No review is recorded for this run' on every file and never sorts findings first. The run page's RunView.useRunReview reads the same key, so the Now banner and triage also see review=null for the rest of the session. A Refresh does not fix it; only a full page reload does.
The old CreatedFiles used useResource keyed on result_uri or status, so it fetched again. Traced through useRunData.ts:44-55, api.ts:226-233 and server/projects.ts:880.

findings.summary: When a worker's inputs exist but its completion is null, the result's own summary and open assumptions no longer appear on the launch node. The verify node still sends the reader to the launch node for the worker's narrative.
findings.failure_scenario: The inputs record the worker (worker !== null) with completion null and handoff null, and the result is loaded. ResultReport renders only when worker === null, and WorkerReport's delta is null when completion is null. The page then shows only 'No completion signal recorded.', and result.summary is not rendered anywhere. Before this slice, WorkerNarrative showed it whenever role.narrative was set.

findings.summary: The section index's Files count comes from filesCount(latest result), while the Files list shows the freeze's paths plus the repair-added ones. The two numbers can differ.
findings.failure_scenario: A repair drops a path, or the latest result lists fewer files than results/<lane>/1. The index chip then reads 'Files N-1' while the heading and the 'All' filter read N. PRD 4.5 expects the chip to count the frozen files ('Files 75 · …').

findings.summary: With no repair marker in the timeline, repair marks fall back to the label 'a repair', which gives ungrammatical wording that credits the change to the operator.
findings.failure_scenario: The verify attempts differ in sha256 but the timeline has no repair marker (for example, markers not yet derived). Rows then read '⚒ a repair · changed', the filter reads 'A repair · n', and the tooltip reads "Changed by the operator's a repair after the worker's freeze".

findings.summary: Dead code left behind: workerSectionEntries (model.ts) and WorkerNarrative (ResultFacts.tsx) are no longer referenced anywhere. answerNext also duplicates triage.ts questionNow word for word instead of reusing now.next for this lane.
findings.failure_scenario: The wording of the answer commands or the caveat changes in triage.ts. The launch page's Questions section keeps the old text while the Now banner shows the new one.

spec_gaps: 4.5 header line 'Working 12m · deadline 11:50 (2h38m left)' / 'deadline paused while question 2 waits' for a running worker is not implemented (declared: NodeHeader.tsx is outside the slice)

Section 10 mobile: tap targets at 44 px or more. File-row summaries stay at min-height 32px and the filters use button-small with no ≤760 px override
4.4 'node-next repeats the Now banner's next step' is now suppressed on a launch node whose question waits. That is intended by the slice brief, but the PRD does not state it explicitly

Questions section header detail from 4.5 ('Question 2 of 3 · asked 11:40 (14 min ago) · deadline paused') and the RUNBOOK reference line are not asserted by launch-question-first. Only the commands, the caveat and the waiting marker are pinned
review.notes: Reviewed `git diff feature/viewer-ux..ux/s4b` (fd55f8b) in /home/agentops/dev/mdm-ux-s4b. `npx tsx --test tests/unit/launch.test.ts` passed. ESLint was clean on the changed src files. ux-launch.spec.ts passed 2/2 in both the worker and the candidate phase; the candidate phase had not been run by the implementer. Checked reportDelta against the real payloads: skeleton-001 comes out as 'extends' (the completion is a prefix of the game/3 summary), and skeleton-fixes-001 and workflow-guardrails-001 come out as 'same'. For verify retries on the same revision (guardrails-001 verify_controller #2, skeleton-001 #2), the sha256 values match, so no false repair marks appear. The one real defect is the review-cache poisoning in CreatedFiles: a 404 on a guessed review URL is stored as a permanent 'ready null'. It is confirmed by tracing the code, not by a browser repro. The test migrations match 12.3. The new assertions can fail on the old behaviour: the old code opened Markdown eagerly, fetching it, and did not sort findings first. The red evidence was assertion failures, not compile errors.

outcomes.item: P1 CreatedFiles.tsx:216 guessed reviews/<n> URL poisons shared review cache
outcomes.note: Verified: orNotRecorded turns the 404 into null, which is cached as ready for good. Now only the snapshot's linked result_uri goes through useRunReview. A guessed path is read with useResource, keyed on the review node's status:attempt plus refreshToken, the way it was read before the slice. New scenario launch-review-late covers it: the snapshot has the review running and unlinked, reviews/1 answers 404, the review is then recorded, and findings sort first after the next poll. It was red before the fix: the first row was vitest.config.ts instead of src/game/room.ts.

outcomes.item: P3 WorkerSections.tsx:130 result summary/assumptions missing when inputs exist but completion is null
outcomes.note: ResultReport now renders when worker === null || worker.completion === null (and role.narrative is set). New scenario launch-report-no-signal covers it. It was red before: worker-summary was not found.

outcomes.item: P3 launch.ts:129 Files chip counts the latest result, not the list
outcomes.note: launchSectionEntries(worker, frozen, latest) now counts with launchFilesCount(frozen, latest), which is fileRows(...).length. WorkerSections uses the same function, so the chip, the section and the heading agree. A unit test covers a later result that drops paths; it was red before (2 vs 5).

outcomes.item: P3 CreatedFiles.tsx:210 'a repair' fallback wording
outcomes.note: New pure helpers repairBadge, repairTitle and repairFilterLabel in launch.ts. With no repair marker a row reads '⚒ changed after the freeze', the filter reads 'After the freeze n', and the tooltip reads 'Changed after the worker's freeze; no repair is recorded for it'. Unit test added; it was red before.

outcomes.item: P3 model.ts dead code (workerSectionEntries, WorkerNarrative) and answerNext duplicating triage questionNow
outcomes.note: Removed workerSectionEntries and filesCount (both unused now) from model.ts. The Questions section now uses the Now banner's own next step (now.next) when the Now situation is this lane's question; NodeDetail passes it as the answer prop. Deferred: WorkerNarrative stays because ResultFacts.tsx belongs to S4a. The answerNext fallback for a second waiting lane stays until triage.ts exports its builder, because section 11 lets only S2/S3 edit triage.ts.

outcomes.note: NodeHeader.tsx belongs to S4-core and is not in the S4b file list. Recorded in the handoff follow-ups.
